name: Knock On Wood Furniture
old_description: Knock On Wood is a family owned and operated business located in Smithfield, Rhode Island.
about:
Knock On Wood Furniture is a family-owned and operated business based in Smithfield, Rhode Island. Founded in 1988, the company has served the Blackstone Valley region for over 38 years.

The company produces a wide range of finished and unfinished solid wood furniture, including desks, entertainment centers, bedroom sets, dining room sets, kitchen chairs, tables, cabinets, and pantries. It also provides custom finishing services, offering a broad selection of stains and paints with color-matching capabilities. Customers can visit a showroom to browse available pieces.

Knock On Wood primarily serves residential customers in the Blackstone Valley area, supplying furniture for kitchens, bedrooms, and dining rooms. Its client base includes homeowners seeking custom-finished pieces and those looking for ready-made solid wood furniture.

The business distinguishes itself through its custom finishing program, which allows customers to select from virtually any stain or paint color and matches existing finishes. This flexibility, combined with decades of local experience, supports its focus on personalized furniture solutions.
